'''Thendra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of [[biochemist]]ry living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], Thendra managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of biochemistry to others.
